knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Description

Computes the future value of an investment given an initial principal, ongoing monthly contributions, and a fixed annual rate of return. It returns a vector of balances for each month over the requested time period.

## Usage

```{r}
calc_wealth(principal, monthly, rate, years)
```

## Arguments

- `principal`: Initial lump-sum investment.
- `monthly`: Monthly contribution amount.
- `rate`: Annual nominal rate of return, expressed as a decimal. Must be non-negative.
- `years`: Investment duration in years.

## Value

A numeric vector containing the projected investment balance at each monthly interval.

## Example

```{r}
wealth <- calc_wealth(principal = 10000, monthly = 500, rate = 0.06, years = 30)
wealth
```
